Job Posting: 179020 - Position: S26 Digital Enablement & Analytics - Summer Student 179020B Co-op Work Term Posted: 2026 - Summer App Deadline Application Method: Posting Goes Live: Job Posting Status: 03/13/2026 03:00 PM Through Employer Website 03/10/2026 03:11 PM Approved ORGANIZATION INFORMATION Organization City Province / State Country Alberta Pensions Services Corporation (APS) Edmonton AB Canada JOB POSTING INFORMATION Placement Term <b> Job Title <b> Position Type Job Location Country Duration Salary Currency Salary Job Description 2026 - Summer S26 Digital Enablement & Analytics - Summer Student 179020B Co-op Position Edmonton, AB Canada 4 months CAD 27.4 per hour for 0 Major List Digital Enablement & Analytics - Summer Student Req #377 Position: Summer Student Digital Enablement & Analytics Position Type: Casual Location: Edmonton, Alberta Classification: Pay Group I Salary Range: $27.40 Plus Vacation & Holiday Pay Duration: May 4, 2026 ending August 28, 2026 Closing Date: March 13,2026 @ 4:00 p.m. MST Position Overview The Digital Enablement & Modernization student provides support to APS' technology modernization, AI adoption, and technical debt reduction initiatives. Working within the Digital Enablement & Analytics team, the student will help research tools and technologies, document and organize use cases, support application rationalization activities, assist with technology assessments, and contribute to early-stage AI solution development. The role offers broad exposure to enterprise technology modernization, analytics enablement, and AI implementation work. It is ideal for a student pursuing education in computing, data, information systems, or related fields. Key Responsibilities • Support APS Technology Modernization initiatives by researching modern tools, platforms, and practices, and documenting options, risks, and alignment with modernization and lifecycle objectives. • Assist with early-stage analysis related to system replacement, modernization opportunities, and application lifecycle reviews, including participation in workshops or working sessions. • Help identify, document, and summarize technical debt, including legacy system risks, dependencies, complexity indicators, and lifecycle concerns, to support prioritization and planning discussions. • Support AI readiness and adoption efforts by researching AI tools and capabilities, documenting potential and existing AI use cases, and contributing to training materials, prompt libraries, and best?practice guidance. • Assist with early AI exploration and lightweight prototyping, such as proofs of concept or demonstrations, and document findings, risks, and insights to support informed decision-making. • Support application inventory and rationalization activities by gathering application information, identifying functional overlaps, and highlighting modernization or consolidation opportunities. • Prepare structured research summaries, visual documentation, and briefing materials, and collaborate across teams and stakeholders while developing practical skills in AI, digital planning, and enterprise modernization practices. Why choose APS APS is made up of hard-working, respectful and talented people who understand and invite diversity to the workplace. We take pride in holding ourselves accountable and continuing to meet or exceed service levels for plan members, pensioners and employers. We ensure they receive quality services because they-along with our people-are the reason we endure and succeed. And it sure feels good helping hard-working Albertans receive their well-deserved pensions. Job Requirements Education Requirements • • Currently enrolled in a post-secondary program in one of the following areas (or similar fields): Computer Science • Information Systems Data Science / Analytics • Skills & Competencies Technical Skills • Foundational understanding of technology concepts such as cloud platforms, application lifecycles, data structures, and software development practices. • Ability to research, interpret, and synthesize technical information from multiple sources. • Interest or introductory experience with AI-enabled tools or technologies, including curiosity about how they can be applied responsibly in an enterprise environment. • Exposure to data analysis, reporting, or visualization concepts and tools. • Familiarity with modern development, version control, or experimentation tools is an asset. Proficiency with standard documentation and presentation tools. • Soft Skills • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills • Curiosity and willingness to learn emerging technologies • Excellent written and verbal communication • Strong organization and attention to detail • Ability to work independently and within a team Comfortable gathering information, asking questions, and synthesizing complex topics • Citizenship Requirement N/A APPLICATION INFORMATION Application Procedure Through Employer Website Special Application Instructions Application Link: Digital Enablement & Analytics - Summer Student | Dayforce Jobs Please click the "I intend to apply to this position" button on SCOPE and also submit your application via the employer's website.
